1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Take the 2D FFT and the power |G|^2 / N.
3. Average the power over 5 x 5 frequencies.
4. Multiply each frequency by max(0, 1 - sigma^2 / P).
5. Take the inverse FFT and keep the real part.
6. Crop the extension.
